# Scan for FIXUP-7 W8 record 8 (ruling W4-006-SPEAKING-VERB).
# Roots say (אמר), answer (ענה) and the kingdom root (מלכ) on the OSHB/WLC words of
# Dan 7:25 and 7:26; the WEB pattern on WEB 7:25 and 7:26; word 4 of 7:25.
import re, sys, unicodedata
SP = r"C:\wt\logos-t423-m8-fable\.ai\scratch\multi_model_bible_chunking\M8_fable\sp_durable"
FINALS = str.maketrans("ךםןףץ", "כמנפצ")


def cons(w):
    s = "".join(c for c in w if "\u05d0" <= c <= "\u05ea")
    return s.translate(FINALS)


ROOTS = {"say_אמר": ["אמר"], "answer_ענה": ["ענה", "ענ"], "kingdom_מלכ": ["מלכ"]}
verses = {}
for line in open(SP + r"\Dan\Dan_oshb.txt", encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n"):
    if "\t" in line:
        ref, text = line.split("\t", 1)
        verses[ref] = text
total = 0
for ref in ("Dan.7.25", "Dan.7.26"):
    words = verses[ref].replace("\u05be", " ").split()
    print(ref, "words", len(words))
    for name, pats in ROOTS.items():
        hits = [(i + 1, w) for i, w in enumerate(words) if any(p in cons(w) for p in pats)]
        total += len(hits)
        print(" ", name, "patterns", pats, "hits", len(hits), hits)
w4 = verses["Dan.7.25"].replace("\u05be", " ").split()[3]
print("Dan.7.25 word 4 surface", w4, "consonants", cons(w4),
      "nfc_codepoints", " ".join("%04X" % ord(c) for c in w4))
PAT = re.compile(r"\b(said|says|say|answered|answer|replied|kingdom|kingdoms)\b", re.I)
chap = None
web = {}
for line in open(SP + r"\Dan\Dan_web_clean.txt", encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n"):
    m = re.match(r"===== DAN (\d+) =====", line)
    if m:
        chap = int(m.group(1))
        continue
    m = re.match(r"\[v\] (\d+) (.*)", line)
    if m:
        web[(chap, int(m.group(1)))] = m.group(2)
for v in (25, 26):
    hits = PAT.findall(web[(7, v)])
    total += len(hits)
    print("WEB 7:%d pattern %s hits %d %s" % (v, PAT.pattern, len(hits), hits))
    print("  text:", web[(7, v)])
print("speak in WEB 7:25:", bool(re.search(r"\bspeak\b", web[(7, 25)])))
print("TOTAL_HITS", total)
